name: no-solo-carry
description: A cooperative card game about redefining success, played online with a phone per player.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @nsc/server" "npm run dev -w @nsc/client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@nsc/client && npm run build --workspace=@nsc/server
